stories.title: Parents fury as Flintshire Council relaunches unchanged Catholic super-school plans
stories.summary: Parents who have spent 15 months campaigning to make their voices heard over Flintshire’s Catholic super-school plans have reacted with anger after the authority re-launched an unchanged proposal for consultation. stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for help to find a 60-year-old woman who has been missing from the Pentre Halkyn area since this morning. stories.title: Online harassment reports to North Wales Police up 135% in two years, FOI shows
stories.summary: Recorded cyber-enabled harassment offences in North Wales have more than doubled in two years, according to figures released by North Wales Police. stories.title: Rhun ap Iorwerth has named his first Cabinet as First Minister of Wales
stories.summary: Rhun ap Iorwerth has named his first Cabinet as First Minister of Wales, with a Plaid Cymru-led minority government taking office in Cardiff. stories.title: Four M53 bridges to be replaced in £50m three-year works package
stories.summary: Drivers using the M53 between Chester and Wirral face three years of disruption from Monday, as National Highways begins a £50m programme of bridge replacements, resurfacing and drainage works.
